answer:
Here is what I would raise at your check-up, most important first.

1. A positive stool test with no follow-up on record. Your stool blood test (FIT) on 4 November 2025 was positive. A positive FIT should be followed by a colonoscopy, usually within a few months. I can find no colonoscopy, GI referral or repeat test after that date, so nearly a year has passed. This is the most important item. It may have been done elsewhere, so tell your doctor and ask for it to be arranged or confirmed.

2. Diabetes checks look overdue. Your last A1c was 6.9% on 16 February 2026, and there is none since, so you are past the usual 3 to 6 month interval. Your kidney tests (creatinine, eGFR 69, potassium) are also from February 2026, and eGFR has drifted from 73 to 69 (still normal range). I see no urine albumin test, eye exam or foot exam recorded. Ask for an A1c, kidney tests and urine albumin now.

3. Metformin was stopped with no reason recorded. It ended 15 April 2024. Your A1c then rose from 6.7% (Jan 2024) to 7.4, 7.9 and 8.3% (Jan 2025). Jardiance 10 mg was started 20 February 2025, and your A1c improved to 7.6, 7.1 and then 6.9%. Ask why metformin stopped and confirm that Jardiance is still the plan.

4. Cholesterol was not rechecked. In February 2025 your LDL was 131 mg/dL and total cholesterol 212, both high. Atorvastatin 20 mg was prescribed that day. I find no later lipid panel, so we cannot tell whether it is working. Ask for a repeat.

5. The chest-pain visit in July 2025 has a confusing entry. A D-dimer was high (0.92), but the CT angiogram showed no pulmonary embolism, and the pulmonary embolism diagnosis is marked refuted. The final diagnosis was chest wall pain, which resolved. Make sure 'pulmonary embolism' is not being treated as a real past diagnosis, and note that a high D-dimer can be non-specific.

6. No routine preventive care is recorded: vaccines (flu, COVID, pneumonia, shingles), mammogram and bone density. At 69 these are worth asking about. These records may simply not include care from other places.

The records cannot show whether any of this was done elsewhere.
